stable_identity_strategy: stable task_id + canonical repo path + source SHA256 for FINAL prose + Git blob SHA/version for mutations
read_freshness_requirements: Read owner main on resume; re-read exact task/checkpoint and Universal lease immediately before material writes.
mutation_conflict_strategy: GitHub blob-SHA or branch-head compare-and-swap; fail closed on mismatch; additionally require current Universal writer lease.
post_write_verification_method: Re-read authoritative owner file(s) from main and compare intended stage/next_action/hash/publication facts before reporting COMMITTED.
upstream_to_downstream_invalidation_rule: Any FINAL prose body hash change invalidates dependent reviews, acceptance, derived DOCX parity and downstream checkpoint references until re-run/rebound.
delete_and_retention_rules: Do not delete published FINAL/Canon history as cleanup. Destructive mutation requires stable identity and dependency check. External publication deletion/replacement remains user-controlled.
superseded_artifact_cleanup_rule: Demote superseded Library active pointers to backup/reference; do not let them remain active competing authorities. Historical evidence may be retained.
external_artifact_vault_if_any: ChatGPT Library stores derived DOCX/render images/recovery ZIPs and historical migration evidence; presence alone never overrides GitHub business authority.
